marks.gloss_en: זאת אומרת -- inferred from R' Meir's ruling that before division [the priest's claim] holds, on the within-thirty reading

R' Yirmeya: that is to say -- two Yosef ben Shimon in one city who bought a field in partnership: a creditor collects it from them, for he says: if my claim is on you I take your share, if on your fellow I take his share
בהא אמר רבי מאיר כי חלקו פטורין? והא אשתעבדו להו נכסי -- after thirty days the property is already mortgaged to the redemption
the mishna's father died after thirty days
לעולם לאחר שלשים יום; with much property he does take -- here there are only five sela (= p_leika_ela_chamesh)
Rava: and where there is much property, indeed he [the priest] takes
כי לא חלקו נמי -- ליזיל לגבי האי ולידחייה, וליזיל לגבי האי ולידחייה: the same pushing-off applies before division
the mishna's father died within thirty days

מכדי נכסי דבר איניש אינון ערבין ביה -- is there anything one cannot claim from the man himself and can claim from the guarantor? והתנן: המלוה את חבירו על ידי ערב לא יפרע מן הערב, וקיימא לן דלא יתבע מן הערב תחלה
the mishna: one who lends to his fellow through a guarantor may not collect from the guarantor (and we hold: may not claim from the guarantor first)
R' Meir: the father died and the sons are alive -- if they gave before they divided, they gave
Rav Asi: brothers who divided are half heirs and half purchasers
one whose wife had not given birth before and she bore two males: he gives five sela to the priest
